name: Iron Sharpens Iron
overview: The Scripture teaches in Proverbs 27:17 that just as iron sharpens iron, so a man sharpens the countenance of his friend, illustrating the importance of mutual encouragement and accountability among believers. This sharpening process reflects the value of godly relationships that build character and honor, as seen in Proverbs 27:18, where faithful service to a master leads to honor. Additionally, Micah 4:13 emphasizes God’s empowerment, likening His strengthening of Zion to making iron horns and brass hooves, enabling His people to overcome their enemies. Together, these verses reveal that spiritual growth and victory are fostered through both divine strength and the refining influence of godly fellowship.
